novel.justification: Uniform positivity and boundedness of the treated conditional-density family is a deliberate, nonstandard primitive condition of this benchmark. It is satisfied by sufficiently small bounded exponential or additive tilts of the uniform density, including the separately smooth families used to model stable outcome support across covariate strata. The condition excludes support degeneration while allowing rough covariate variation and imposes no restriction on the control-arm law.
